paths: basic name, region, intro and multiple public-answer drafts survive real app-tab navigation without any server write; the public preview continues to show saved data only
saving one public field preserves basic-profile and sibling public drafts while changing only its own saved answer, without mutating private preferences, history or consent
saving the basic profile retains an unrelated public-answer draft without silently publishing it
each successful save clears its own draft and later navigation displays the stored values instead of reviving an obsolete pre-save edit
the explicit discard action for one public field restores its saved value and leaves sibling public and basic-profile drafts untouched without a server mutation
discarding the basic-profile group restores saved name, region and intro without erasing another public draft; the discarded edits stay discarded after returning to the tab
a newer saved version of the same public field invalidates that stale local draft while preserving unrelated public and basic-profile inputs
a newer saved basic-profile value replaces the conflicting local edit without replaying stale text over it or clearing an unrelated public-answer draft
reaching a saved public-answer deadline discards an older unsaved edit and keeps the expired answer absent from the public preview

a revision conflict caused by a semantically unchanged stored field retains the valid draft after refresh but discards the old confirmation; the unchanged preview updates only after a fresh explicit review and successful save
turning saved-preference consent off and back on clears pending profile and public drafts and does not revive them after navigation
unsaved profile drafts stay in the current page memory rather than local/session storage and are absent after reload and from another authenticated account
a real local-server authentication rejection removes the current view and raw drafts; later authenticated reload uses stored values and cannot revive the former edits

public multiselect regions, required checkbox and custom deadline survive navigation and an unrelated basic-profile save, including selection count and deadline input enabled state, without publishing the draft
confirming restored compound drafts sends exactly the chosen regions, required flag and Korean-local custom deadline, while single-field saving preserves the sibling draft
a slow basic-profile request locks the submitted inputs while pending, unlocks after success and leaves an unrelated restored custom-deadline input enabled and editable
a rejected slow save unlocks the same inputs, retains the unsaved draft for correction and leaves stored profile data and sibling custom-deadline inputs intact
when a public-field save reaches the server but its response is lost, receipt recovery performs no second action POST, returns to its preview row and retains unsaved basic and sibling public drafts
receipt recovery for a committed basic-profile save also returns to the saved preview without resending, clears only the committed draft and leaves the unrelated public answer unpublished
editing a public preview row focuses its exact form; explicitly returning before saving focuses that preview row and still displays only the stored answer without writing the draft
reopening the same preview field resumes its unsaved answer; saving it returns automatically to the original preview and focuses the newly stored row
editing the preview basic card opens the settings editor and saving returns to the original profile-page preview with saved name, region and intro and focus at the basic card
starting a public edit from the settings preview returns to that same settings preview after save, instead of sending the user to another tab
